title: Bound Type B stage-17 body transfers with fixed paid slots
body:
## Result and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** With the signed #7113 caller on exact #7334, two independent derivative replays rule out moving a stage-17 body factor from Type B local root 0 to isolated rail 32 at either singleton idle clock, 4646 or 4660. A joint rewrite of both slots also fails with J17 fixed. Exact core minors and the independent rail entries exclude 16 one-factor and 36 distinct two-factor endpoints (72 labelled matchings). No cases remain unresolved in this two-slot window.

The proposed one-factor transfer keeps paid ranks fixed and has an optimistic saving below 0.537159504482460 raw. No supported edit realizes it. Changing J17, using other stages or changing the body-dependent interface remains open. The benchmark is #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

CPython 3.12 on POSIX. Four exact receipts match after relocation. Committed bytes, modes, source history, registered replay, corrupted-input controls, official Git-free export and six navigation checks passed locally. The branch retains #7257's CI prerequisites.
